name: GraphQL & Apollo Federation
description: Curated toolsets and architectural guidelines for GraphQL schema design, subgraph composition, and query optimization.
best_practices: Resolver batching via DataLoader: Wrap queries in DataLoader to mitigate N+1 roundtrips.

Query depth limits: Enforce query complexity and depth limits to protect against DoS.
Schema governance: Automate breaking change checks with Rover and GraphQL Inspector.
